corrections.reason: The cross-reference for Malachi 3:1 in Matthew is Matthew 11:10 (ማቴ ፲፩ ፲), and visually the numeral after ፲፩ is a single-stroke ፲ (10) rather than ፪ (2).
In Luke 7:33, the Ge'ez imperfect 2nd person plural is ወትብልዎ ('and you say of him', from ይብል), printed with 6th-order ብ (ወትብልዎ) rather than 5th-order ቤ.
